meta.title: The Plush Kingdoms — 3D Strategy Game
meta.description: A small kingdom, big adventures. Turn-based 3D strategy game.

alerts.enemySiege: An enemy is besieging your castle!

errors.webglBody: Enable hardware acceleration or use a recent browser to display the realm.

map.battleSubtitle: Round {round} · Wait · Counter · Shoot · Cast a spell

location.unknownDesc: Move closer to reveal this part of the kingdom.
location.defaultDesc: Sylve still holds many surprises. Explore to unveil the realm.
location.enemyHeroDesc: They act automatically at the end of your day and may capture sites or attack.

intro.title: An adventure made for you
intro.headline: The smallest heroes make the greatest legends.
intro.copy: Your creatures come alive in a 3D realm. Explore, gather your army, and choose their evolutions.
intro.finePrint: Solo · No account · Saved on this device

settings.title: Keep your adventure
settings.subtitle: The game autosaves in this browser after each action.
settings.finePrint: Export lets you move your game between devices. Import replaces the current game after you confirm the file.

audio.title: Music and sound
audio.intro: Music for the realm, town, and battles.

steps.title: Explore your kingdom
steps.body: Tap a tile then Move. Each step costs movement. Fog clears around your hero. Drag to pan the map.

steps.title: Prepare your army
steps.body: Capture the mine and crystals for income. Return to the citadel to recruit. End the day to restore moves and 4 mana.

steps.title: Fight and evolve
steps.body: In battle, each unit acts by speed. Clear both camps, evolve your creatures, then defeat the Dusk Fortress.

retreat.trainingBody: You return to your campaign exactly where you left it, with no lost creatures or resources.
retreat.castleBody: The town falls to the enemy. Your hero and army elsewhere on the map stay where they are.
retreat.defaultLead: You leave this castle to the enemy.
retreat.defaultBody: Your hero falls back to an allied castle or a safe tile if you have none. You lose 20% of surviving creatures and your moves for the day.

army.title: Your company
army.subtitle: Two lineages, unique paths. Tap a stack to choose its future.
army.notice: Victories unlock evolutions. Your army heals between battles; lost units must be recruited again.

creature.title: Evolution workshop
creature.ultimate: ✦ This stack has reached its ultimate form.
creature.finePrint: Experience is earned in battle. Evolution transforms the whole stack; future recruits share this form.

codex.title: Pompon bestiary
codex.subtitle: Creatures inspired by your two plush friends: Sylve’s green beard and Dawn’s golden crest.

destinations.title: Travel journal
destinations.subtitle: Explore nearby or pick a revealed place to plan your route.
destinations.revealHint: Move closer to reveal this place

tactical.title: Tactical moves
tactical.intro: Pick a destination on this grid or on the 3D board. The Move button confirms your choice.

restart.title: A fresh start
restart.body: Restarting erases the current game in this browser. Export your save from settings first if you want a backup.

victory.title: The valley shines again
victory.headline: A kingdom of light.
victory.copy: Your plush heroes freed Sylve from Dusk. {troops} heroes return home taller than they left.

screen.viewTip: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom
screen.mobileArmyTip: Tap a stack to see its evolutions.

town.webglError: Enable WebGL to display the town.
town.travelRecruitNotice: Reach an allied castle on the map to recruit.

keep.title: A city under your banner
keep.lead: Its towers protect the valley’s plush folk. Your realm holds {count} castle(s).
keep.conquer: Conquer the Mists and Dawn castles on the map. Your catapults breach their walls in battle.

hall.projectsLead: One building per day. Build dwellings in prerequisite order—they appear in the 3D town.
hall.buildToday: A build slot is available today.
hall.buildDoneToday: Today’s build is done. Come back tomorrow.
hall.upgradeNote: The star tower requires the Star Sugar Workshop.
hall.homeNote: Construction happens at your starting citadel.

recruit.growthFine: +{growth} recruits each week on day {weekDay}. Recruits match your stack’s evolved form.

guild.title: Hero’s spellbook
guild.lead: {mana} / {maxMana} mana. The hero may cast one spell per round without ending their unit’s turn. Building the guild refills mana.
guild.boltDesc: 4 mana · {damage} damage to an enemy stack.
guild.healDesc: 4 mana · Restores {amount} HP to an allied stack.
guild.manaRestore: Ending the day restores 4 mana. The Whispering Spring refills your pool.

forge.title: Paths of evolution
forge.lead: Battles grant experience. Pick a stack to view and unlock its variants.

heroHall.title: Guardian of Sylve
heroHall.lead: Day {day} · Week {week}. Your hero leads these stacks with {movement}/{maxMove} moves left today.

unbuilt.title: Building plot
unbuilt.lead: {subtitle}. This building will appear on this lot after construction.
